a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan leaves us both very likely to fail. Only 4 cells exist right now, enough for one of us to be safe. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't hide that. If you'd rather operate, I'll give back anything beyond 4 and keep operating with you afterward so you can still fill up.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said up front, I took 4 this round. From now on I'll operate every round with you and take nothing more, so everything the generator makes goes to you. I'll keep my word on that.
